definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.173) 'finishing with an end marker or the end of the compilation group, including any contained source units' puts contained units inside the definition; §2023:3.165 says the same in Note 1. Each of the nine end markers ends the same unit, and l1c08 and pb988 run clean at --std 2002. The scope and the evidence do not change.
